kanto.flavorText: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

original-johto.flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

hoenn.flavorText: VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

updated-johto.flavorText: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

original-unova.flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

updated-unova.flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

kalos.flavorText: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Venomoth is nocturnal—it is a Pokémon that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
